title: ModernUpdates
description: Adds some vanilla+ and and a bit of fantasy mods perfect for survival.
body:
**Ever wanted a lightweight, versatile, and realistic modpack?**


![Modern Updates](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e632422dfbb12ddbaf45d25e736a0280a5ff7aa5_0.webp)

       
   The perfect _Modern Update_ for your serevr or singleplayer world!
                                                                 


This is a lightweight modpack designed for fabric that allows you to have the perfect realistic experience in minecraft. For all people with a laggy PC or Laptop but want a lifelike experience in minecraft on Fabric Launcher.

INCLUDES
- *Effective [Thanks to Ladysnake]
- *Better Leaves
- *Better Lanterns
- *Connected Glass
- *Better 3D Beds
- *Fresh Animations (Thanks FreshLX)
- *Fresh Food (Thanks Cyber)
- *Blocks Expansion
- *Decorative Blocks
- *Mo Glass
- *Terralinth
- *Many Immersive Weather Mods
- *Shaders!
- *MANY MORE MODS INCLUDED!!!

Effective Details - adds water animations to all water based biomes and improves rain quality to make minecraft more realistic.

Better Leaves Details - Adds hyper-realistic details to all leaves making them so much fluffier and cooler.

Better Lanterns Details - Makes the lantern model have more depth when paired with LambDynamicLights - Dynamic Lights it produces the ultimate result with perfect lighting combined with awesome models.

Connected Glass - Kind of self explanetory, adds a new tab which allows for 3 new types of glass.

Better 3D Beds - Adds an awesome bed model that tucks you in when you go to bed.

Fresh Animations - Adds animations that upon interacting with villagers will immerse you into the game making it feel like real life.

Fresh Food - Adds 3D models to many of the foods in a fashion like Fresh Animations.

Blocks Expansion and Decorative Blocks - Both essential and beautiful, keeping minecraft in the vanilla style while adding so many unique and well crafted blocks to the game.

Mo Glass and Many other glass addons- Adds glass stairs and slabs along with reinforced glass (Other glass mods).

Terralinth - Most people know this one but I will say that it adds 100+ Biomes to the game to explore across your world!

Many immersive weather mods - this is about three mods or so that enhance the game with seasons, snow, disasters, and more!

Shaders - Obvious, just makes the game look beautiful with a finishing touch.
